description: Fetch a complete curriculum dataset - the actual words, not a description of them: 857 items across 9 datasets (Dolch sight words and nouns, CVC families, digraph words, Spanish syllables, Turkish-English word and flashcard sets). Use when you need exact word lists for a lesson, worksheet, quiz, or flashcard set; these sequences and level boundaries are canonical ground truth and should not be generated from memory. Do not use when you need an interactive activity or tool metadata - use search_classroom_tools or get_classroom_tool instead. Behavior: read-only, idempotent, no authentication or rate limits; one unpaginated call returns the complete filtered array (max 220 items) in canonical order, identical on every repeat, with a SHA-256 content_hash of the full dataset. Values are matched exactly; an unknown dataset_id or a level_or_family foreign to the chosen dataset returns error -32602 with no partial results; omitting level_or_family returns the full dataset.

dataset_id.description: Required. Exact slug from the enum; any other value returns error -32602. The chosen dataset determines the shape of items in the response: the six English/Spanish sets return arrays of strings; the three Turkish-English sets return arrays of {tr, en} objects. Item counts: dolch-sight-words-220 (220), dolch-nouns-94 (94), cvc-word-families-75 (75), digraph-words-21 (21), spanish-syllables-core (212), turkish-english-early-words (30), turkish-english-animals (193), turkish-english-colors (5), turkish-english-objects (7)

level_or_family.description: Optional sub-filter whose valid values exist only relative to dataset_id: Dolch levels (pre-primer, primer, grade-1, grade-2, grade-3), CVC rimes with leading hyphen (-at; the bare form at is accepted and normalized), digraphs (sh, ch, th, wh), Spanish subsets (syllables, words). dolch-nouns-94 and the Turkish-English sets have no subsets - omit this parameter for them. Omitting it always returns the complete dataset; a value foreign to the chosen dataset returns error -32602 rather than an empty result

name: get_curriculum_dataset

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full unfiltered dataset; changes only when the data changes

dataset_id.description: Stable dataset id in the form birkanyavuz:<name>:v1

invocation_id.description: Unique receipt id for this call

item_count.description: Number of items in this response after filtering

items.description: The complete filtered items in canonical order; element shape depends on the dataset (see dataset_id)
A word or syllable string (monolingual datasets), or an object with tr and en fields (Turkish-English pair datasets)

record_digest.description: One-line citation naming the dataset, creator and endpoint

resource_uri.description: Stable edu:// URI for this dataset, readable via resources/read

title: Get Curriculum Dataset (Word Lists and Syllables)
